page.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable rule set — a directive description plus a markdown body. Write one, or import a SKILL.md.

card.disabledTitle: Disabled — left out of every agent's prompt
card.deleteBody: It is bound to {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}; those bindings go with it. This cannot be undone.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive — what the agent must check and how. This line is the skill's interface; the body carries the detail.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag promise .then() chains where async/await reads clearer.
config.tokensTitle: Estimated (characters ÷ 4) — the server counts the exact number at run time.
config.trustNotice: Imported skill. This text came from outside your workspace and becomes part of the instructions of every agent that binds it — read it before you bind it.
config.deleteConfirm: It is bound to {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}; those bindings go with it. This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

stats.pullHint: Share of this workspace's finished runs (last 30 days) whose prompt carried this skill.
stats.acceptHint: Accepted ÷ (accepted + dismissed) over findings from runs that carried this skill (last 30 days).
stats.findingsHint: Findings produced by runs that carried this skill in the last 30 days.
stats.noRuns: No finished runs in the last 30 days.
stats.noActions: No finding from these runs has been accepted or dismissed yet.
stats.noAgents: No agents bind this skill yet — attach it on an agent's Skills tab.

evals.title: Evals
evals.body: Eval cases for skills arrive with the Eval lesson. When they land, "Run on evals" will replay this skill's cases here and score recall, precision and citation accuracy.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored. Diff a version against the one before it, or restore an older body as a new version.
versions.initial: Initial version — nothing came before it.
versions.noChange: No text changes in this version.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: Text and configuration only — a skill never runs code. Its body lands in the prompt of every agent that binds it.
create.defaultBody:
# Rule

When reviewing a diff, check … and report a WARNING with the exact file:line when …

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: A .md file, or a .zip with a SKILL.md inside. Only the markdown core is read — nothing in an archive is run, extracted or written to disk.
import.ignoredHint: Listed for transparency: these members were not read, extracted or executed.
import.trust: Someone else's skill is someone else's instructions in your agent's prompt. Read the body before you confirm.
import.successToast: Imported "{name}" — bind it on an agent's Skills tab.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: A public link to a SKILL.md (or a .zip). The server fetches and parses it — nothing is saved until you confirm.
